title: eugenia pyriformis var. uvalha
intro: Eugenia pyriformis var. uvalha, commonly known as the 'Uvalha Guava', is a plant species native to Brazil, belonging to the Myrtaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in the prevention and treatment of various diseases. The Uvalha Guava's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia pyriformis var. uvalha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
